entries.name: Peter Lumsdaine

expected.sentence: Two-year federal prison sentence for the May 10, 1992 Rockwell satellite action, imposed September 21, 1992. Exact post-sentencing admission and release remain unverified; the previous June 1992 endpoint did not establish release from this sentence.

updates.charges: Rockwell satellite action — initial pretrial detention
updates.sentence: Initial detention from May 10, 1992 ended on bail in mid-June 1992, according to the Plowshares chronology, printed page 50. June 1 is a MONTH-precision storage placeholder, not the actual release day. Electronic monitoring followed. The two-year sentence imposed September 21, 1992 belongs to later custody; its separate federal endpoint was March 2, 1994. No continuous May 1992–March 1994 interval is asserted.

sources: Arthur J. Laffin, The Plowshares Disarmament Chronology 1980-2003, printed p.50 / PDF p.62 (user-supplied book).
entries.rationale: Separate initial bail release from later sentence custody; exact June day remains unresolved.
